_comment: Static objects in chart coordinates (metres). Spheres: x, y, z, radius. Pillars: x, y, radius, height. Boxes: x, y, z, half size. Universe A has spheres_A and pillars_A, universe B has spheres_B and boxes_B. The shader gives each sphere its own colour, in this order, and takes as many spheres in each universe (Tracer._fits_shader).
